about: Driven tools on an Okuma lathe: SB= is the speed of the driven-tool spindle and never the speed of the main spindle, M13 starts that spindle without touching the main one, G181 drills until G180 cancels it, and G184 taps with a feed tied to the pitch.

states.about: SB=2000 is an address of its own: the main spindle has no speed yet, and M13 is not the main spindle's code, so its state is still the M05 of line 6.
G181 is a modal cycle start (AD-19 rule 2): it stays in force over the next hole positions.
G184 taps: its F is tied to the pitch (pitchFeed), and the cycle stays in force until G180.
